pages.title: Goblins
text: Small, quick and spiteful, goblins come one to three at a time and go straight for you.

pages.title: Two kinds
text: - **Fen Goblin**: the Reed Fen. It rises on the open ground at night.
- **Tunnel Goblin**: the dark tunnels under the Steppe, where it rises day or night.
A goblin has **18 health** and **1 armour**, is quick, and hits for **4**.

pages.title: What they give
text: A Fen Goblin drops **1 to 2 Goblin Ears** (lime dye), a Tunnel Goblin **1 to 2 Goblin Fangs**, more with Looting. Both are Hound reagents: anointed, they make a weapon drink back part of every blow. See [reagents](reagents).
